p: Zadok: Who was high priest after Abiathar was deposed, according to the prophecy of Eli the priest, 1Sa 2:31,35.
priest's office in the temple that: And valiantly resisted king Uzziah, who would have usurped the priest's office 2Ch 26:17,18.
Jehozadak went into captivity: That is, he was led into captivity with his father Seraiah the high priest, 2Ki 25:18.
Amminadab his son: Who seems to be called Izhar, Ex 6:21.
Vashni: Who is also called Joel, 1Sa 8:2, 1Ch 6:33.
rest: After it was brought to the place where the temple would be built and was no longer carried to and fro.
Asaph: Meaning, the son of Heman, 1Ch 6:33.
brethren also the Levites were: The Levites are called the singers brothers because they came from the same stock.
appointed unto all manner of service: Read Nu 4:4.
dwelling places throughout their castles in: Or, cities which were given to the Levites.
lot: They were first appointed, and prepared for.
Hebron in the land of Judah: Which was also called Kirjatharba, Ge 23:2, Jos 21:11.
refuge: That he that had killed a man might flee to it for help till his case was tried, De 19:2.
Hilen with her suburbs: Which Joshua called Holon, Jos 15:51,21:15.
Alemeth with her suburbs: Or, Almon Jos 21:18.
Kohath: That is, they gave a portion to the Kohathites, who were the remnant of the tribe of Levi, out of the half tribe of Manasseh and out of Ephraim, 1Ch 6:66.
Gershom were given out of the: Who in the first verse is also called Gershon.
